thread:
mia: ran a quick bring-up for mosaic-7b q8x4 on A100 vs H100 across us-west1/eu-west1. attaching short digest from bench-bot.
bench-bot: upload: bench/1768504321/mosaic7b_q8x4_snapshot.csv :link: 
bench-bot: summary: H100 prefill p50 18ms p95 45ms; decode p50 6ms p95 22ms; tokens/sec 3200; $/1M tokens $14.7. A100 prefill p50 28ms p95 78ms; decode p50 10ms p95 40ms; tokens/sec 1900; $/1M tokens $22.1. (kv_hit=0%)
sam: whoa that $ delta is bigger than I expected. are these single-turn gen numbers?
mia: single-turn, 256 token prefill + 256 decode window, batch size 1. no KV cache.
kai: did you try varying kv hit? that usually flips the prefills a ton.
bench-bot: extra sweep attached: bench/1768504321/kv_hit_sweep.csv :link: 
bench-bot: kv_hit 60% -> H100 tokens/sec 4800, A100 2600; $/1M H100 $10.1, A100 $16.9. kv_hit 95% -> H100 tokens/sec 8200, A100 4200; $/1M H100 $6.0, A100 $10.5.
devon: interesting — so with decent KV caching the H100 advantage is ~1.9x tokens/sec, but prefill latency still matters for p95 tail. any region diffs?
mia: yes, ran us-west1 vs eu-west1 to see kernel fallthroughs. eu-west1 had more kernel fallbacks on A100 because of driver pack differences.
infobot: noticed kernel:fast_attention failed on A100-eu-west1 nodes for seq=1024, fallback to tiled_mm, which increased decode p95 by ~18ms.
sam: can you paste the small log snippet?
mia: ```
[2026-06-03T14:12:03Z] kernel_select: model=mosaic7b seq=1024 -> attempted fast_attention (cuDNN-like) -> error code -102 -> using tiled_mm (4x tile)
[2026-06-03T14:12:03Z] runtime: kv_cache_miss=true prefill_ms=86 decode_ms=38
```
kai: that explains the A100 p95 spike in eu-west. any quantization regressions on output quality for q8x4 vs q4?
mia: we ran a small eval harness (n=500 prompts) comparing q8x4 (our main) vs fp16 baseline. rouge/bertscore delta within noise. q4 gave ~2% BERTScore drop on certain instruction-following prompts.
devon: thanks. ops question: for Dedicated capacity sizing, should we assume H100 price parity or the observed effective $/1M tokens?
sam: for capacity planning use observed $/1M tokens at target kv_hit and mix; e.g., for chat apps expect 60% kv_hit and bursts so use $10.1/M for H100 baseline. but also plan for region-specific kernel fallbacks with 20-30% effective perf degradation on older A100 clusters.
kai: small config tips: enable prefix packing, kv_cache=true, and set batching.max_tokens=4096 to keep latency stable while increasing throughput. try kernel_pref=fast_attention on H100-only fleets.
mia: next steps: 1) repro the A100 kernel failure on eu-west with driver 470 vs 510, 2) run a steady-stream burst test (qps mix) with 60% kv hit and 95th tail capture, 3) push a canary Dedicated config with H100-only for high-throughput customers.
devon: assign to infra to repro, I'll file a ticket.
infobot: created ticket INFRA-1287: reproduce A100 fast_attention fallback in eu-west1 (assigned to kai).
sam: nice. also annotate the bench csv with the region/node kernel versions so PMs can see the source of variance.
mia: will do and share a condensed chart for the eng-ops call tomorrow. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
